name: Leitir
tagline: Library searches, loans and renewals on leitir.is
description: Search for books and other library materials on leitir.is without signing in. Sign in to see your loans, due dates and fines, renew loans and cancel holds.
examples: Is Ronja ræningjadóttir available at my library?
When are my library books due?
Renew the loans for all books due this week.
auth: none for search; kennitala/library card + PIN for account features

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the catalogue (local Icelandic holdings or worldwide), with limit/offset/sort

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Autocomplete suggestions for a partial query

tools.name: loans
tools.description: Active loans with due dates, days left and renewability

tools.name: requests
tools.description: Hold requests with status, pickup location and cancellability

tools.name: renew_loan
tools.description: Renew one loan by ID or fuzzy title match

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: Cancel one hold request by ID or fuzzy title match

envVars.name: LEITIR_TOKEN
envVars.description: JWT to use instead of the cached login token

envVars.name: LEITIR_USERNAME
envVars.description: Kennitala / library card for leitir login

envVars.name: LEITIR_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose renew/cancel MCP tools

envVars.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
envVars.description: Base config dir; token cached in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/leitir-cli/token.json

is.tagline: Bókaleit, útlán og endurnýjun á leitir.is
is.description: Leitaðu að bókum og öðru safnefni á leitir.is án þess að skrá þig inn. Með innskráningu geturðu séð hvað þú ert með að láni, skoðað skiladaga og sektir, endurnýjað lán og hætt við frátektir.
examples: Er Ronja ræningjadóttir til á bókasafninu mínu?
Hvenær á ég að skila bókunum?
Endurnýjaðu lán á öllum bókum sem á að skila í þessari viku.
